title: OK, but one has damaged and faulty parts
text: OK, but one has damaged and faulty parts. I got two orders of these stools. The first two stools were easy to assemble. They each took about 10-15 minutes to assemble. They seem very sturdy. When I got to the third stool, there were many issues. First, there was a piece that had the peg holes and screw holes swapped, so the pegs were too big to fit in the screw holes. Second, the bars that go across the legs at the footrest were cut at an angle in the wrong direction, so they didn't fit correctly, which created a gap at the bottom and top where the leg attaches to the seat. There was also a little damage on the stool seat. I'll get a paint pen to fix the damage on the seat, but I'm going to need to contact Amazon about getting these parts replaced, if they can do that.
